issues.display_title: Issue #27: ops: provision CockroachDB database, secure user, and native vector storage for GoThru RAG
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

Provisioned and configured a dedicated CockroachDB database on the production cluster (192.168.1.227:26257) to support persistent knowledge base storage, native vector search (1536-dimensional embeddings), and hybrid retrieval for GoThru RAG Copilot.

Environment & Infrastructure

  • Database Server: 192.168.1.227 (CockroachDB v26.2.2 CCL)
  • Port: 26257 (SQL), 8080 (Web UI)
  • Security Mode: Secure mode with TLS/SSL encryption (sslmode=require)
  • Target Database: gothru_rag
  • Database User: gothru_rag_user

Tasks Completed

  • Create dedicated database: CREATE DATABASE gothru_rag;
  • Create secure user with password authentication: CREATE USER gothru_rag_user WITH PASSWORD '...';
  • Grant ownership and all privileges: ALTER DATABASE gothru_rag OWNER TO gothru_rag_user;
  • Verify SSL/TLS connectivity from application servers (apil-2) with sslmode=require
  • Verify native vector DDL support (VECTOR(1536) and cosine_distance())
  • Run initial knowledge base & vector seeding via scripts/seed_cockroach.py:
    • 104 knowledge documents seeded
    • 97 action contracts registered
    • 104 vector embeddings (1536-dim) generated via Gemini and persisted

Verification & Status

  • Connection tested and verified from gothru-apil-2 (192.168.1.178).
  • Service gothru-rag.service reporting healthy database status on GET /health.
  • All 164 unit, integration, and DB tests passing.
